## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the full legal text of a licence ([spdx:licenseText](http://spdx.org/rdf/terms#licenseText)) — typically only for a custom or bespoke licence whose text is not a standard SPDX-identified one.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inlining the text of a standard licence (reference it by [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) and resolve the canonical text by reference, P5) and avoid using it as the licence identity.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:licenseText`](gmeow-licenseText.md) on a [`gmeow:License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) only when the full text must travel with the data; otherwise carry [`gmeow:spdxLicenseId`](gmeow-spdxLicenseId.md) and let consumers resolve the SPDX text.

### Examples

- ex:customLicense [`gmeow:licenseText`](gmeow-licenseText.md) "[`Permission`](../classes/gmeow-Permission.md) is hereby granted …".
